verdict.rationale: Steel's browser is open source, and the steel-browser repo ships a pre-built Docker image (API plus UI) that drives Chrome over Puppeteer/CDP. That implies you can run it yourself on your own machine and connect via Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium. However, every integration doc describes running against Steel cloud sessions. No documentation shows pointing the SDK, CLI or agent integrations at a local instance, or confirms that no account or API key is needed. missing for 10: explicit local/self-hosted setup docs, confirmation that no cloud account or API key is required, evidence that SDK/CLI/agent integrations work against a local instance, hands-on corroboration.
